observations.behavior: Adds four new Linode endpoint configurations: images, databases, database_types, and lke_node_pools, including dependent fan-out for node pools.
observations.posthog_connection: These endpoints enable ingestion of Linode-managed database and Kubernetes node pool metadata, including hierarchical relationships between clusters and pools.

observations.behavior: Adds two new service entries to the Linode source configuration documentation and metadata.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion system to recognize and process the new LKE node pool resource type.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and tests for monthly transfer ingestion, including incremental field handling, watermark-based pagination, and deletion handling.
observations.posthog_connection: These tests demonstrate that the ingestion system correctly handles incremental resyncs, respects watermarks, and skips deleted resources, which is critical for reliable warehouse data consistency.
